mapper.select: SELECT t.address address, t.app_ver_code AS 'appVerCode', t.industry_code AS 'industryCode', t.remind_time AS 'remindTime', t.link_id AS 'linkId', t.order_status AS 'orderStatus', t.overdue_remind_sign AS 'overdueRemindSign', t.remind_process_id AS 'remindProcessId', t.warning_order_id AS 'warningOrderId', t.warning_type_id warningType_id, t.alarm_time AS 'alarmTime' FROM `vm_overdue_remind_t` t where DATE_FORMAT(t.remind_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') = #{remindTime}
